proposed_widenings.name: ApplyConditionEffect (spell Effect union)
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell's save_gate onFail must apply a condition (blinded or deafened). The Effect union for ActivationPhase only has DamageEffect | NoneEffect. The v4 atom apply_condition exists but is absent from the spell Effect union.
proposed_widenings.evidence: One creature ... must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or it has the Blinded or Deafened condition

proposed_widenings.name: Condition: "blinded" | "deafened"
proposed_widenings.justification: The Condition type only contains "prone". Blindness/Deafness requires "blinded" and "deafened". These are standard SRD conditions and will be needed by many spells and features.
proposed_widenings.evidence: or it has the Blinded or Deafened condition (your choice) for the duration

proposed_widenings.name: repeat_save ActivationPhase variant
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell has an ongoing repeat-save-to-break mechanic: at the end of each target turn, the target repeats the save and ends the spell on success. ActivationPhase has attack_roll and save_gate but no repeat_save variant. v4 atom repeat_save exists but is unrepresented in the surface.
proposed_widenings.evidence: At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

proposed_widenings.name: caster_choice_condition (Effect or ActivationPhase variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: The caster chooses at cast time whether the condition is blinded or deafened. No existing surface type models a 'choose one of [conditionA, conditionB] at caster's discretion' mechanic. This differs from a random or target-determined branch.
proposed_widenings.evidence: or it has the Blinded or Deafened condition (your choice) for the duration

notes: All four blockers are new variants of existing surface types (Effect, Condition, ActivationPhase). The v4 atom inventory already contains apply_condition and repeat_save; the gap is purely in the surface schema. The slot-scaling for higher-level casting (+1 target per slot above 2) fits the existing SlotScaling<number> / choose_up_to pattern used by Bless. If apply_condition, blinded/deafened, and repeat_save are added, the remaining issue is the caster-choice-of-condition, which may need a ChoiceEffect variant or a condition set on ApplyConditionEffect.
